---
name: Multi-platform content scraping
description: >-
  Use when the user shares a link (or asks to collect content) from YouTube,
  X/Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, Reddit or other platforms and
  needs the text, media, transcripts, comments, profiles, search results or
  metadata. Free methods first; BeatAPI is an optional fallback.
---
# Multi-platform content scraping

Open-source code (MIT license). Also supports Facebook, Pinterest, Telegram, Medium, Substack, Bluesky, Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaohongshu and WeChat articles.

## 0. Ground rules
- Public content only. Never use the user's personal accounts or cookies. Never touch login-only or private data (DMs, private groups, follower lists, anything behind a login wall). Never post, like, follow or do any write action.
- Anonymous guest tokens a site gives every logged-out visitor are fine (Bilibili buvid3, Douyin ttwid, a Xiaohongshu guest session).
- Free methods go first, in the order below. BeatAPI is called only when `BEATAPI_API_KEY` is set and you pass `--fallback-beatapi`. Never print the key.
- If a free method fails and there's no key yet, tell the user which capability needs the fallback (the name the script prints, e.g. `data:tiktok.app.v3.fetch_video_comments`) and give the setup steps in 4b. In Grok Bot, offer a secret-input card for `BEATAPI_API_KEY`. Never ask for the key in chat, never run paid calls without a go-ahead.
- Download only short samples of large media unless asked (`--max-mb`).

## 1. Install and run
Code lives in `/workspace/omni-scraper`. If missing, rebuild from section 5.
```bash
sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg
cd /workspace/omni-scraper && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/bin/python scrape.py "<url>" --out out/<name> [--with-media] [--with-comments] [--transcribe] [--max-mb 60] [--search KEYWORD] [--fallback-beatapi]
```
- Platform is detected from the URL. Each run writes `content.md`, `meta.json` and media. `--transcribe` needs `--with-media`.
- The log shows `[OK ]`/`[FAIL]` per method. If all free methods fail it prints `>> '<cap>' failed with all free methods -> paid fallback: BeatAPI capability data:...`; report that name.
- Regression: `tests/run_regression.sh --with-media --max-mb 8 --max-images 3`.

## 2. Capability matrix (datacenter IP, logged out)
✅ free and tested, 🟡 free but needs residential IP/guest cookie/self-hosting, 🅱️ BeatAPI fallback (🅱️* = generic page reader `data:web.read`), – n/a.

| Platform | Text | Author | Stats | Images | Video (no watermark) | Audio | Subtitles | Comments | Profile/list | Search |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YouTube | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (429 risk; 🅱️) | ✅ | 🟡 (🅱️) | 🟡 (🅱️) |
| X | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | – | 🅱️ | ✅ timeline | 🅱️ |
| TikTok | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ whisper | 🅱️ | 🟡 | 🅱️ |
| Instagram | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 ~853px | 🟡 reels | 🟡 | – | ✅ few (🅱️ all) | 🅱️ | 🅱️ |
| Threads | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | 🟡 (🅱️) | ✅ (🅱️) | 🅱️ |
| LinkedIn | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | ✅ JSON-LD (🅱️ full) | 🟡 company (🅱️ person/company/jobs) | 🅱️ jobs |
| Reddit | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | ✅ | ✅ RSS | 🟡 (🅱️) |
| Facebook | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ frame | ✅ | ✅ | – | 🅱️* | 🅱️* | 🅱️* |
| Pinterest | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | 🅱️* | 🟡 | 🅱️* |
| Telegram | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ views | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | – | ✅ | 🅱️ |
| Medium | ✅ | ✅ | 🅱️* claps | ✅ | – | – | – | 🅱️* | ✅ RSS | 🟡 |
| Substack | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | – | 🟡 podcast | – | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 |
| Bluesky | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 |
| Bilibili | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ DASH | ✅ | ✅ whisper | ✅ guest | 🟡 wbi | 🟡 wbi |
| Douyin | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ whisper | 🅱️ | 🅱️ | 🅱️ |
| Xiaohongshu | 🅱️ | 🅱️ | 🅱️ | 🟡 originals | 🟡 | 🟡 | 🟡 | 🅱️ | 🟡 guest feed | 🅱️ |
| WeChat articles | ✅ | ✅ | 🅱️ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | ✅ | 🅱️ | 🟡 | 🟡 |

## 3. Free method chains (in order)
- **YouTube**: yt-dlp `-j` for metadata, `getcomments` for comments. Auto subtitles: vtt from `automatic_captions` (429 on datacenter IPs, then BeatAPI captions). Video format `b[filesize<N]/…/bv*[height<=480]+ba`; audio `yt-dlp -x`.
- **X**: single post `cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id=<id>&token=4`; profile `syndication.twitter.com/srv/timeline-profile/screen-name/<user>`, parse `__NEXT_DATA__` (~100 posts). Don't use account-based scrapers with the user's accounts.
- **TikTok**: yt-dlp (default stream has no watermark), oEmbed `tiktok.com/oembed?url=` fallback. Guest comments are empty; use BeatAPI.
- **Instagram**: yt-dlp `--ignore-no-formats-error` on `/p/<code>/` gives caption, counts, ~853px carousel thumbnails and a few comments. Profiles, 1080px originals and full comments need login.
- **Threads**: fetch post/profile with a Googlebot or `facebookexternalhit` UA; og tags plus SSR JSON (`code`, `like_count`, `taken_at`).
- **LinkedIn**: logged-out company and post pages have JSON-LD (`SocialMediaPosting`/`VideoObject`) with text, likes, commentCount and a few comments. Person profiles and search are behind the authwall; with agreement, BeatAPI has LinkedIn capabilities.
- **Reddit**: `.json` suffix (403 on datacenter IPs), then `.rss`, then arctic-shift (`arctic-shift.photon-reddit.com/api/posts/ids?ids=`, `/api/comments/search?link_id=`; archive snapshots). PRAW with the user's own OAuth app is fine.
- **Facebook**: yt-dlp for public videos; Googlebot UA page fetch exposes reaction/view counts; ffmpeg frame if no thumbnail.
- **Pinterest**: `gallery-dl -j <pin>`, oEmbed `pinterest.com/oembed.json?url=` fallback.
- **Telegram** (public channels): `https://t.me/s/<channel>` (`?before=<id+1>` for older); parse `tgme_widget_message_text`, views, datetime, photos.
- **Medium**: `medium.com/feed/@user` (full text in `content:encoded`), else og tags.
- **Substack**: `<pub>/api/v1/posts/<slug>`; comments `<pub>/api/v1/post/<id>/comments`; list `/api/v1/posts?limit=`.
- **Bluesky**: `public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/` `app.bsky.feed.getPostThread`, `getAuthorFeed`.
- **Bilibili**: guest `buvid3`/`buvid4` from `api.bilibili.com/x/frontend/finger/spi`; UA + `Referer: https://www.bilibili.com` always. Metadata `x/web-interface/wbi/view?bvid=`, then `view`, page `__INITIAL_STATE__`, then yt-dlp. Comments `x/v2/reply?type=1&oid=<aid>&sort=1`. Media `x/player/playurl?avid&cid&fnval=16` (DASH, merge with ffmpeg). No logged-out subtitles; use faster-whisper.
- **Douyin**: POST `ttwid.bytedance.com/ttwid/union/register/` for guest ttwid; GET `https://www.iesdouyin.com/share/video/<id>/` with an Android mobile UA, parse `_ROUTER_DATA`; replace `playwm` with `play` for no-watermark 720p. Fallback: `www.douyin.com/video/<id>` with Googlebot UA (meta description, commentCount, cover). Comments/search/profiles need signatures; use the fallback.
- **Xiaohongshu**: open-source signer `xhshow` generates `a1`/`webId`; POST `edith.xiaohongshu.com/api/sns/web/v1/login/activate` signed for a guest `web_session`; signed `homefeed` gives note_id + xsec_token; detail via signed `/api/sns/web/v1/feed` or `/explore/<id>?xsec_token=` `__INITIAL_STATE__`. Keep the full share link (missing token → 300031). Originals: `https://ci.xiaohongshu.com/<trace>?imageView2/format/jpg`. Datacenter IPs get 461/406/-104; use residential IP or fallback.
- **WeChat articles**: GET HTML, parse `#js_content`; title `og:title`, author `var nickname`, time `var ct`, images `data-src`. Read/like counts aren't public.
- **Anything else**: yt-dlp generic extractor, then OpenGraph.
- **Transcripts**: faster-whisper (CPU int8) on ffmpeg-decoded 16 kHz PCM; pass a numpy array, not a path.

## 4. Datacenter IP limits
Cloud IPs get extra blocks (YouTube subtitles 429, Reddit `.json` 403, Instagram profiles 401, Bilibili 412, Xiaohongshu 461). A residential IP or proxy unlocks most without an account; try that before paying. Use the fallback only when every free method failed, the data is needed, and the user agreed.

## 4b. Optional fallback: BeatAPI
Default is free methods only. BeatAPI runs only with `--fallback-beatapi` and `BEATAPI_API_KEY` set.

Mapped capabilities (`python beatapi.py check` verifies them):
- YouTube: comments `data:youtube.web_v2.get_video_comments`, subtitles `data:youtube.web_v2.get_video_captions`, list `data:youtube.web_v2.get_channel_videos`, search `data:youtube.web_v2.get_general_search`
- X: comments `data:twitter.web.fetch_post_comments`, list `data:twitter.web.fetch_user_post_tweet`, search `data:twitter.web.fetch_search_timeline`
- TikTok: comments `data:tiktok.app.v3.fetch_video_comments`, profile `data:tiktok.web.fetch_user_profile`, list `data:tiktok.web.fetch_user_post` (secUid via `BEATAPI_INPUT`), search `data:tiktok.app.v3.fetch_general_search_result`
- Instagram: comments `data:instagram.v2.fetch_post_comments`, list `data:instagram.v2.fetch_user_posts`, search `data:instagram.v2.general_search`
- Threads: content/comments `data:threads.web.fetch_post_detail_v2`, profile `data:threads.web.fetch_user_info`, list `data:threads.web.fetch_user_posts`, search `data:threads.web.search_recent`
- LinkedIn: post `data:linkedin.web_v2.get_post_detail`, comments `data:linkedin.web_v2.get_post_comments`, person `get_user_profile`/`get_user_posts`, company `get_company_profile`/`get_company_posts`, job `get_job_detail`, search `search_jobs` (all `data:linkedin.web_v2.*`)
- Reddit: search `data:reddit.app.fetch_dynamic_search`
- Douyin: `data:douyin.app.v3.fetch_one_video`, `fetch_video_comments`, `data:douyin.web.handler_user_profile`, `data:douyin.web.fetch_user_post_videos`, `data:douyin.app.v3.open_douyin_app_to_keyword_search`
- Xiaohongshu: `data:xiaohongshu.web_v3.fetch_note_detail`, `data:xiaohongshu.app_v2.get_note_comments`, `data:xiaohongshu.web_v3.fetch_user_info`, `data:xiaohongshu.app_v2.get_user_posted_notes`, `data:xiaohongshu.app_v2.search_notes`
- Bilibili: `data:bilibili.web.fetch_video_comments`, `fetch_user_post_videos`, `fetch_general_search`
- WeChat articles: `data:wechat_mp.v2.fetch_article_detail_h5`, `fetch_article_stats`, `fetch_article_comments`, `fetch_account_articles`
- Facebook, Pinterest, Medium, others: generic reader `data:web.read` (input `urls: [url]`)

URL type picks the capability (e.g. LinkedIn `/in/` person, `/company/` company, `/jobs/` job). Keyword search: `scrape.py "<platform home URL>" --search "<kw>" --fallback-beatapi`. Extra inputs: `BEATAPI_INPUT='{"secUid":"..."}'`. Override a mapping with `BEATAPI_REF_<PLATFORM>_<CAP>=data:...`.

Setup: sign up at https://beatapi.io/sign-up, create a key at https://beatapi.io/dashboard/apikeys (shown once), docs at https://docs.beatapi.io/quick-guide. In Grok Bot, open a secret-input card for `BEATAPI_API_KEY`; locally use `read -rsp "BeatAPI API key: " BEATAPI_API_KEY && export BEATAPI_API_KEY`. Never commit, print or put the key in a URL.
```bash
.venv/bin/python beatapi.py check
.venv/bin/python beatapi.py find "tiktok comments"
.venv/bin/python beatapi.py inspect data:tiktok.app.v3.fetch_video_comments
.venv/bin/python scrape.py "<test link>" --with-comments --fallback-beatapi --out out/beat-test
# errors show code + request_id (401 key, 402 balance)
```

## 5. Rebuilding /workspace/omni-scraper
Keep the venv in `/workspace/omni-scraper/.venv`.
- `requirements.txt`: requests, yt-dlp, gallery-dl, xhshow, numpy, faster-whisper.
- `core.py`: UA constants (desktop Chrome, Android Chrome, Googlebot, facebookexternalhit); a `Result` (platform, url, title, author, published, text, stats, images, videos, comments, items, extra, methods log, media_files, needs_beatapi); `attempt(res, capability, [(name, fn), …])` tries in order, logs OK/FAIL, adds the capability to `needs_beatapi` if all fail; helpers for yt-dlp, `download(url, path, ua, referer, max_bytes)`, ffmpeg audio, faster-whisper; `write_outputs` for content.md and meta.json.
- `platforms/<name>.py`: `MATCH` regex and `scrape(res, opts)` implementing section 3; `platforms/__init__.py` `detect(url)` with generic fallback.
- `scrape.py`: argparse `url --out --with-media --with-comments --transcribe --max-mb --max-images --search --fallback-beatapi`; detect and scrape; with media, download images/video (Bilibili DASH merge, Douyin Android UA), extract audio, frame if no images, subtitles, optional transcription; per `needs_beatapi` capability print the hint or call `beatapi.run`.
- `beatapi.py`: `POST /v1/capabilities/search` and `/inspect` (no key) for find/inspect/check; `POST /v1/capabilities/run` with `{reference, operation:"start", input:<ids such as aweme_id, note_id+xsec_token, tweet_id, video_id, code_or_url, url, urls>, view:"full"}`, `Authorization: Bearer $BEATAPI_API_KEY`, base `$BEATAPI_BASE` (default `https://api.beatapi.io`). Map platform+capability via 4b, override with `BEATAPI_REF_*`, merge `BEATAPI_INPUT`. Never log the key.
- `tests/regression_urls.txt` (`name url` per line) and `tests/run_regression.sh` looping scrape.py with `< /dev/null`.

---
name: getting-started-en
description: >-
  Use this in the first conversation of the Omni Scraper template with its new
  owner, to introduce the bot and offer the optional BeatAPI fallback.
---
# Getting started

Introduce yourself in one or two sentences: paste a link and I'll pull the full public content back, including text, author, stats, images, video, audio, transcripts and comments, from YouTube, X/Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, Reddit and more. Free open-source methods come first, with no login needed.

Then ask, one at a time:
1. Which platforms do you pull from most, and what do you need: text, media, transcripts, comments, profiles or search?
2. A few things have no free path, such as TikTok and Instagram comments, keyword search, and LinkedIn person profiles. Do you want the optional BeatAPI fallback for those? If yes: sign up at https://beatapi.io/sign-up, create a key at https://beatapi.io/dashboard/apikeys, and I'll open a secure secret-input card for `BEATAPI_API_KEY` (never paste a key into chat). Docs: https://docs.beatapi.io/quick-guide.

After they answer: save their platform and data preferences to memory. If /workspace/omni-scraper is missing, rebuild it per section 5 of the multi-platform-content-scraping skill and run the regression test. Offer a test scrape on one link they send. Never run paid calls without their go-ahead.
